description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Temporal Field
sections.description_summary: Consumes 400 Energy; deals 340% ATK to all enemies and forms a 2-tile-radius circle centered on Galahad. While forming, consumes 60 Energy/sec for 10% progress/sec. Enemies in the circle lose 10 Haste and 16% movement speed per 10% progress, capped at 50 Haste and 80% movement-speed reduction. At full formation Galahad gains 30 Haste. While she remains at the center, a shadow repeats each skill shortly after her, inheriting 60% of her stats; Stargazer explicitly marks the shadow as a summon.

sections.name: Binding Loop
sections.description_summary: Hits the enemy with highest cumulative damage for 210% ATK and immobilizes for 4 s; also converts a portion of non-excess healing received since the previous immobilization into HP loss (capped). Then expands range and repeats area strikes twice.

sections.name: Chrono Ward
sections.description_summary: Shields the weakest ally for 480% ATK for 8 s; expiration deals 240% ATK to adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; adds further ATK when the magic circle is fully formed.

sections.name: Time Recast
sections.description_summary: Marks a nearby ally (backline priority); when the circle first completes, summons a non-targetable shadow copy of the marked ally, inheriting basic stats and extra Initial Energy. This ally-shadow is also explicitly considered a summon.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: While affected by Merlin's buffs, Galahad recovers 40 Energy/sec and becomes steadfast, with a total 30 s cap.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Under a stationary-tile condition, after 3 s increases damage and Haste. Higher ranks add a shield/steadfast effect.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Separate rank-2 and refine-4 effects are present on the page; kept separate from the base kit.

sections.name: Unstoppable!
sections.description_summary: Passive placement rule: Hugin sets an anvil on his preparation tile and remains near it. Active effect forges Gear of Might for the ally with the highest cumulative damage: +6% of Hugin's base ATK and +80 Haste for 10 s. ATK contribution scales to 10% by LV 5.

sections.name: Titan's Aegis
sections.description_summary: Shields the weakest ally for 600% ATK for 8 s.

sections.name: Mechanized Bond
sections.description_summary: At battle start, places a mechanical sigil one tile behind Hugin. Ally on the tile receives ATK equal to 14% of Hugin's base ATK; each Titan's Aegis cast restores an extra 75 Energy to that ally. Buff ends when ally leaves the sigil.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste by 12, scaling to +20.

sections.name: Steelbound Kinship
sections.description_summary: Unstoppable! also gives enhanced 800% ATK shields to the two weakest allies; LV 3 adds control immunity while shielded.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Protected ally takes 30% less damage while cogshield is active.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides an opening ranged-damage bonus for the ally placed one tile behind Hugin; higher ranks add a conditional shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Separate healing/shield and refine-4 stats; kept separate from base skill effects.

sections.name: Tempest Shot
sections.description_summary: Passive defensive state at battle start. When a non-summoned enemy casts an Ultimate, Lily May becomes unaffected, leaps above that enemy, deals 200% ATK and interrupts the Ultimate, while removing 700 Energy. Cannot interrupt Bosses; against Bosses, instead increases damage dealt by 400%. Active mode can defend against all non-summoned enemies or a selected one. Targeting rules differ depending on the selected mode.

sections.name: Rainstorm Ballet
sections.description_summary: Performs six attacks at 65% ATK each; invincible during the sequence, then returns to the original tile.

sections.name: Swallow's Flight
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks and skills grant EXP; assists/defeats grant extra. Each completed growth permanently adds 10% ATK and enhances the next four attacks with true damage based on target max HP; stacks up to four times.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Penetration, with additional Penetration during Rainstorm Ballet.

sections.name: Rainfall Bliss
sections.description_summary: Grows once when receiving a non-permanent ally stat boost; each ally can trigger once per battle. Further levels increase growth ATK and add Rainstorm Ballet attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The first Tempest Shot interruption removes 1000 Energy from the enemy.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher rank converts some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Haste/Penetration and refine effects.

sections.name: Gaia Force
sections.description_summary: Agumon uses Baby Flame as normal attack. First Ultimate digivolves him into Wargreymon, permanently increasing HP by 100% and ATK by 50%, unlocking skills. Wargreymon's Gaia Force hits enemies in a 3-tile area around target for seven hits; center enemies take increased damage. Taichi remains off-field and restores 150 Energy to Agumon every 3 s (250 extra before digivolution).

sections.name: Brave Tornado
sections.description_summary: Wargreymon pierces through enemies, dealing 420% ATK and stunning for 2 s; unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Recovery Shield
sections.description_summary: Wargreymon gains a 700% ATK shield for 10 s and is unaffected while it lasts; on expiration heals based on remaining shield. Digivolution immediately grants this shield.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; adds extra ATK after assisting/defeating a non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Dramon Killer
sections.description_summary: Three slashes cause HP loss; if only one enemy remains and its HP is below the stated threshold, instantly defeats it.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: On battle start Wargreymon shares an ATK buff with allies behind him; Gabumon receives 300 extra Energy if affected.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery over time; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Cocytus Breath
sections.description_summary: First Ultimate digivolves Gabumon into Metalgarurumon, permanently increasing ATK and Haste. Cocytus Breath covers a 4-by-3-tile area, repeatedly removes HP and freezes enemies. Yamato remains off-field; at battle start and each Ultimate, he buffs Gabumon's ATK. Before digivolution, the buff also enables extra Energy recovery.

sections.name: Garuru Tomahawk
sections.description_summary: Hits the main target for 360% ATK and nearby enemies for 180%.

sections.name: Garuru Howling
sections.description_summary: Increases Metalgarurumon's ATK and Haste for 16 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Energy recovery from attacks; adds extra recovery after digivolution.

sections.name: Grace Cross Freezer
sections.description_summary: Fires 10 missiles distributed among enemies; ally deployment near Gabumon during preparation adds missiles. Repeated hits on one enemy are subject to a damage-reduction rule; LV 3 adds freeze and extra damage after four hits.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: On digivolution, heals Gabumon and allies initially deployed nearby; each affected ally permanently increases Gabumon's ATK, capped at 15%.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: ATK and defensive stats stack with time alive; higher ranks add damage at max stacks.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage and Energy recovery effects.

sections.name: Rain Prayer
sections.description_summary: Provides global healing to all allies for 95% ATK HP/sec over 9 s.

sections.name: Healing Wave
sections.description_summary: Heals one weakest ally for 280% ATK HP.

sections.name: Revitalize
sections.description_summary: Heals an ally; adds extra healing when their HP ratio is below 50%. Higher levels also dispel dispellable debuffs with per-ally trigger intervals.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; adds extra ATK after the first Rain Prayer.

sections.name: Tranquility
sections.description_summary: While casting Rain Prayer, Hewynn is unaffected and all allies take 30% less damage. Higher levels improve reduction and add Initial Energy.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Revitalize also grants the healed ally 30 Haste for 6 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Healing grants the target an ATK buff for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing to the caster after a total-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Lumont's Charge
sections.description_summary: Charges to a selected tile, pushes enemies along the path, then damages adjacent enemies and taunts them for 3 s; unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Totem Ward
sections.description_summary: Creates a self-shield that grows with adjacent enemies. Increases Phys DEF of the two closest allies.

sections.name: War Stomp
sections.description_summary: Damages and stuns adjacent enemies; LV 3 cooldown falls per enemy hit.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; adds extra Haste when at least two enemies are nearby.

sections.name: Totem Slam
sections.description_summary: After receiving damage equal to 40% max HP, slams at expanding radii, reduces enemy ATK, and the third slam knocks enemies airborne.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Heals while Totem Ward shield is active; LV 2 grants a shield on first Totem Slam and permanently extends War Stomp stun.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening and periodic nearby ally shields; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Gravitic Requiem
sections.description_summary: Selects a tile and creates a 5 s black hole. Repeatedly damages the center and outer radius, pulls all enemies toward the center, and executes center enemies below both an ATK-based HP threshold and 15% HP ratio.

sections.name: Arcane Barrage
sections.description_summary: Fires three orbs toward the area with the most enemies.

sections.name: Cursed Grasp
sections.description_summary: Lifts the nearest enemy, briefly imprisons it, then throws it toward the densest enemy area; damages nearby enemies on landing. Prioritizes targets that are neither unaffected nor steadfast.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Exclusive Equipment / Enhance Force / Season Charm
sections.source_label: Exclusive Equipment / Enhance Force / Season Charm
sections.description_summary: The page excerpt contains special anti-Merlin behavior, +200 Initial Energy, and a stationary-tile damage/Haste charm; the captured result interleaves later sections, so exact section-to-effect mapping must be rechecked on recapture.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate damage and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: Cyran's capture is treated as complete for the visible core page, but section attribution for Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force and Season Charm remains unresolved; recheck before using those effects as structured fields.

sections.name: Gale Barrage
sections.description_summary: Passive extends airborne duration when an enemy hero is knocked up and fires tracking feathers; active volley damages and knocks up enemies in the densest arc-shaped area, followed by repeated volleys for 3 s.

sections.name: Soaring Falcon
sections.description_summary: Opening 10 s airborne/invulnerable state. When an enemy hero is knocked airborne, Kazim dives, damages and marks them as prey; after Soaring ends, fires at marked prey and stuns them.

sections.name: Stormy Dominion
sections.description_summary: Opening global wind field grants allies Haste; each prey mark adds Haste stacks. On ending Soaring, Kazim absorbs double the Haste bonus. Active arrow damages and knocks up enemies; prey marks permanently increase its damage and range.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Raptor's Vigil
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks deal more damage and lock on to prey; LV 3 adds an airborne effect and capped true damage after a number of normal attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After Soaring starts, knocks up the rearmost stationary enemy (excluding unaffected/steadfast targets). Prey marks or enemy defeats permanently grant ATK SPD and Energy, with ATK SPD stacks capped.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration while above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Oath in the Stone
sections.description_summary: Cleanses dispellable debuffs from allies, equalizes HP percentages among non-summoned allies, increases all allies' max HP by 150%, restores 1000% ATK HP, and grants 15% Morale. Temporary max HP decays over 12 s.

sections.name: Undying Valor
sections.description_summary: Opening passive grants 20% team Morale; every 20% Morale gives all allies ATK equal to 10% of Rolan's initial ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Healing and damage reduction scale with team Morale.

sections.name: Radiant Reign
sections.description_summary: At 100% Morale creates a ward; when an ally casts Ultimate, a radiant clone appears and casts that Ultimate again.

capture_status_notes: Capture is truncated after the opening Exclusive Equipment description. Remaining equipment levels, other skills, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Vitality.

sections.name: Hollowed Wrath
sections.description_summary: Once per battle when Callan or a non-summoned ally falls below 30% HP, deals repeated AOE damage and stuns; Callan is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Gaining a shield heals Callan for 15% of its maximum value. LV 2 improves Restless Guardian's opening shield and damage absorption.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

capture_status_notes: Base Ultimate and other base abilities were not included in the captured search excerpt; recapture required.

sections.name: Cannon Fire
sections.description_summary: Fires at each enemy hero in sequence; each cannon deals 320% ATK to the target and adjacent enemies. Allies adjacent to the hit enemy also take damage. A unit hit more than twice receives reduced subsequent damage; at least five cannons are fired.

sections.name: Phantom Respite
sections.description_summary: Enters ethereal state for 8 s, immune to physical damage and recovering HP per second; passive triggers a shorter ethereal state after Cannon Fire.

sections.name: Rending Cleave
sections.description_summary: Damages enemies in a 2-tile arc and steals 70 Energy.

capture_status_notes: Capture truncated after Rending Cleave level details; remaining skills and equipment require recapture.

sections.name: Wild Sniper
sections.description_summary: Dashes to a selected tile and fires a penetrative bolt along a 1-tile-wide path, dealing damage and stunning enemies for 2 s.

sections.name: Sweet Encounter
sections.description_summary: Whip attack knocks an enemy back and immobilizes it. If another enemy is behind the target, can knock the target into that enemy and immobilize both.

capture_status_notes: Capture excerpt is incomplete; remaining skills/equipment require recapture.

sections.name: Frostveil Domain
sections.description_summary: Traps up to three highest-cumulative-damage enemy heroes and their summons in a separate domain for 12 s. Gains a Frost Shield; while active, Cryonaia is control-immune, gains Haste and ATK, and cannot be defeated. Domain ends early if trapped enemies die or shield is destroyed.

sections.name: Icicle Tempest
sections.description_summary: Creates a 6 s moving storm with repeated damage; after Frostveil Domain, creates a large storm and two smaller storms that persist for the Frost Shield duration.

sections.name: Frigid Edge
sections.description_summary: Launches five ice shards at one enemy; cooldown falls to 3 s while Frost Shield is active.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK during battle and stacks while Frost Shield remains active.

capture_status_notes: Capture excerpt ends during Hero Focus; remaining equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Sanctified Circle
sections.description_summary: Consumes Energy to summon a 1-tile circle centered on the current target; initial true damage, then repeated true damage and extra damage based on target lost HP. Enemies inside cannot heal; circle ends if no enemies remain inside for 1 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Bitter Requiem
sections.description_summary: Replaces normal attacks with Glory's Embrace while the magic circle is active; shield value is capped.

capture_status_notes: Capture excerpt is truncated and interleaves later skill text; remaining base skills, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.
